proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / TRUST FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR 2017 SUMMARY`, `Page 1 of 3`, PDF page 37 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM, COLUMN BY COLUMN: `ACCOUNT NUMBER` | `FUND NAME` | `FY 2017 BEGINNING PRINCIPAL` | `FY 2017 BEGINNING EARNINGS` | `FY 2017 CONTRIBUTE TO PRINCIPAL` | `FY 2017 NET EARNINGS` | `FY 2017 DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` | `FY 2017 TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` | `FY 2017 ENDING CASH VALUE` | `FY 2017 UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` | `FY 2017 ENDING MARKET VALUE`. Every column heading was READ off the page and written down; none is inferred. THE `ACCOUNT NUMBER` COLUMN IS PRINTED AND EMPTY on every row of this page. WHAT THE PAGE HOLDS, counted off the page rather than off any dataset: THREE groups and TWENTY-TWO funds -- `CEMETERY FUNDS` (3), `CONSERVATION FUNDS` (5), `LIBRARY FUNDS` (14) -- each group closed by its own `SUBTOTALS` line. It is page 1 of 3; the scholarship, miscellaneous and stabilization groups and the statement's `GRAND TOTALS` are on page 38. HOW IT WAS READ: the page is a SINGLE EMBEDDED SCAN -- pdfplumber returns one word (the folio) and one image -- so the scanner's own pixels were taken straight off the PDF with pypdf, rotated upright and cropped into two column blocks, each with the fund-name strip pasted beside it so a figure stays attached to the row it is printed on. Neither render script was used, so neither could clip it. WHAT PROVES IT, three ways, AND EVERY ONE CLOSES TO THE CENT WITH NO TOLERANCE AT ALL. (1) TWENTY-TWO ROW IDENTITIES: beginning principal + beginning earnings + contribute to principal + net earnings + disburse from principal + transfers of earnings = `ENDING CASH VALUE`, on all 22 funds, exactly. (2) TWENTY-SEVEN COLUMN SUBTOTALS: nine columns against each of the three printed `SUBTOTALS` lines, all 27 exactly. (3) THE STATEMENT'S OWN `GRAND TOTALS`, WHICH ARE PRINTED ON PAGE 38 AND FOOT ACROSS BOTH PAGES: this page's three subtotals plus page 38's three add to all nine printed grand totals to the cent -- $2,273,700.80 / $187,191.63 / $112,634.17 / $31,649.20 / ($19,335.24) / ($18,314.75) / $2,567,525.81 / ($23,347.80) / $2,608,445.39. That cross-page reconciliation is `fy2017-p37-trust-grand-totals.csv` and it is what makes the `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` and `ENDING MARKET VALUE` columns checkable at all. *** THIS PAGE STATES NO IDENTITY LINKING `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` TO `ENDING MARKET VALUE`, AND THE ONE THE ADJACENT YEARS STATE DOES NOT HOLD HERE. *** FY2018 page 44 and FY2021 page 40 both close on `ending cash value + unrealized gain/loss = ending market value`. On this page that identity fails on every row: PERPETUAL CARE BEQUEST is $187,455.81 cash and ($1,847.76) unrealized against an ending market value of $190,443.36, which is $4,835.31 the other way. What the figures DO show is that `ENDING MARKET VALUE` divided by `ENDING CASH VALUE` is 1.015937 on every one of the 22 funds and on all three subtotal lines, and that `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` divided by `ENDING CASH VALUE` is -0.009857 on every one -- two constant pro-rata allocations across the whole page. THAT IS A REGULARITY, NOT AN IDENTITY THE PAGE STATES, so it is NOT used as a check here: offering it as one would be a hypothesis dressed as a proof. WHAT THE COLUMN MEANS IS NOT ESTABLISHED -- cumulative unrealized gain, the year's change in it, and a custodian's allocation all fit the same figures -- and nothing on the page says. The two columns are instead proved by their subtotals and by the cross-page grand totals, which is what rule 7b's advice amounts to for a column no row identity touches. ONE FUND NAME IS CLIPPED BY THE DOCUMENT ITSELF. The last library row prints `ANNIE & ARTHUR BILLINGS CULTURAL TR` and the name runs into the `BEGINNING PRINCIPAL` column and is cut off there by the page, not by the reading. It is transcribed as the page prints it; the full name is not recoverable from this page. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. A trust fund balance is not money the town may spend: the purpose, the restriction and the donor's terms are nowhere on this page, and nothing here says which of these funds is expendable. `TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` and `DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` record that money moved; they do not say where it went or what it bought. And the ACCOUNT NUMBER column being empty means these funds cannot be joined to the general ledger from this page.
